crossRefs.note: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”
The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and…

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.
translations.bsb: How the mighty have fallen in the thick of battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
translations.kjv: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.
translations.asv: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan is slain upon thy high places.
